Staff Vacancy
Saturday, 10 August 2024
6586 Hits
Applications on plain paper enclosed with the certified photocopies of the educational qualification and experience are invited for the below mentioned posts which must reach to the Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Po. Sevagram, Dist. Wardha 442102 latest by
24/8/2024
.
Registration with Local Employment Exchange is mandatory, copy of the same to be submitted along with application
.
Librarian
: 1 Post (Open)
Qualification
&
Experience
– M.Lib. with at least five years’ experience as Librarian / Assistant Librarian  managing library with more than 25000 books and digitalized library in Medical College / Technical institutes like engineering. Person with additional qualification like Ph.D./NET/SET / Information Technology and experience in Digital Library preferred.
Salary:
Rs.50000/- per month consolidated during probation of two years.   After successful completion of probation may be considered for Pay Level   S-13 Rs.35400-112400.
Senior Assistant : 1 Post (Open)
Qualification & Experience
– Post graduation in any discipline from recognized Institute / University. Candidate must have 10 years’ experience as Head Clerk / Senior Clerk in Medical / Engineering Institute in the field of Human Resource management. Must have knowledge about handling various Human Resource functions like Leave, Attendance, Service Book maintenance, Promotion, Recruitment, Service Rules etc. knowledge of English, Noting, Drafting, Pay Fixation, departmental inquiry etc. Candidate having Bachelor degree in HR/ Business Administration or in related field will be preferred.
Accountant :
1 Post (Open)
Qualification & Experience
– Graduation in Commerce from recognized University in India, proficiency in operating the computerized system and should have dealt with the maintenance of Books of Accounts like cash book, ledger, journal, stock-books and the process of scrutiny of bills and pay bills, drawing salaries, should have adequate knowledge about Income Tax Laws, Provident Fund, Professional Tax, etc. He/ She should also have knowledge of preparing a budget, drawing the profit/ loss accounts, balance sheet, etc. with experience of 5 years or more in and organization having an annual turnover of Rs. 25 Crores and above.
Health Educator : 1 Post (Open)
Qualification & Experience
– Graduation from recognized Institute / University with Diploma in Health Education/ Certificate course in Health Education from a recognized University / Institute. Candidate with experience of working in Community based programs within organization of repute or Medical Institute with more than 500 beds will be preferred.
Tutor – 6 Posts
Qualification & Experience
– MBBS / M.Sc. in Medical Anatomy, Medical Physiology, Medical Biochemistry from a recognized Institute.
Junior Clerk cum Data Entry Operator
-
3 posts (1 OBC, 2 Open)
Qualification & Experience
– Graduation from Govt. recognized Institute approved by   University, MSCIT with proficiency in operating computers and two years' experience as Clerk in a Medical College or in a Hospital with 500 or more beds.
Salary:
For Sr. No. 2, 3, 4, 5 & 6 as per Kasturba Health Society’s Rules
Age Limit
: Between 18 to 38 years for General Candidate/ between 18-43 for reserved candidate
Note:
1. Application to be submitted to the Dean, MGIMS for the above mentioned posts
Suitable & experienced candidates can be considered for relaxation in age limit.
Dean reserves right to reject any or all application as deemed appropriate
Decision of Selection Committee will be final and binding.
Institute reserves the right to adopt varying selection process for different post.
Only eligible candidates will be called for Written / Skill test and shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification / Interview.
Swachhata Pakwada September 2024
